contract_tests: tests/test_itsdangerous/test_timed_malformed_ts.py::test_invalid_signature_out_of_range_timestamp_raises_bad_time_signature: crafts an invalid signature whose decoded timestamp is far outside datetime's supported year range; asserts BadTimeSignature is raised (not ValueError), exc.payload == b'value' (original payload bytes), and exc.date_signed is None.

tests/test_itsdangerous/test_timed_malformed_ts.py::test_invalid_signature_out_of_range_timestamp_payload_type: asserts the raised exception's payload is exactly bytes and equals the original value bytes, and date_signed is None (exact type NoneType).

tests/test_itsdangerous/test_timed_malformed_ts.py::test_valid_roundtrip_unchanged: signs b'value' with TimestampSigner and asserts unsign returns b'value' (bytes), and unsign(return_timestamp=True) returns (b'value', datetime) with tz-aware UTC datetime.

tests/test_itsdangerous/test_timed_malformed_ts.py::test_ordinary_invalid_signature_date_signed_metadata: crafts an invalid signature with an in-range timestamp; asserts BadTimeSignature with payload == b'value' and date_signed equal to the expected aware UTC datetime (metadata preserved).

tests/test_itsdangerous/test_timed_malformed_ts.py::test_expiry_behavior_unchanged: signs with a past timestamp and asserts SignatureExpired is raised with payload == b'value' and date_signed equal to the aware UTC datetime of the timestamp.

tests/test_itsdangerous/test_timed_malformed_ts.py::test_timed_serializer_malformed_timestamp_raises_bad_signature_family: TimedSerializer.loads on a crafted invalid signature with out-of-range timestamp raises a BadSignature-family exception (isinstance BadSignature) and not ValueError.

tests/test_itsdangerous/test_timed_malformed_ts.py::test_timed_serializer_valid_roundtrip_unchanged: TimedSerializer.dumps/loads roundtrip returns the original object and loads(return_timestamp=True) returns (payload, aware UTC datetime).
patches.rationale: In TimestampSigner.unsign, the invalid-signature branch computes ts_dt = self.timestamp_to_datetime(ts_int) without guarding against datetime range errors. When an invalid signature decodes to an out-of-range timestamp, datetime.fromtimestamp raises ValueError (or OverflowError/OSError), leaking a raw error instead of BadTimeSignature. Fix: wrap that conversion in try/except and fall back to date_signed=None, preserving the original payload. Valid roundtrips, ordinary invalid-signature metadata, expiry behavior, and the TimedSerializer BadSignature-family contract are untouched. New regression tests are added in a NEW file tests/test_itsdangerous/test_timed_malformed_ts.py.

repair_feedback.instruction: Compare the observed assertion with the ORIGINAL issue. Correct source or an unjustified NEW test; existing tests stay immutable.
